sentences.en: Every language is equally precious and valuable to its speakers.
sentences.zh: 每一个语言对其使用者来说都是同样珍贵和有价值的。

sentences.en: The prize was divided equally among the ten syndicate members.
sentences.zh: 奖品被平均分给了十个辛迪加成员。

sentences.en: Every language is equally precious and dear to its speakers.
sentences.zh: 每一种语言对于它的使用者而言都是一样宝贵的。

senses.zh: 相等地,同等地均等也,同样
